run_get_vocab_words: run get_vocab.py to print words and their frequencies from a fasttext model's dictionary
run_get_vocab_labels: run get_vocab.py with --labels flag to print labels and their frequencies from a fasttext model
test_get_words: test the fasttext model's get_words method with include_freq=True to retrieve words and frequencies
test_get_labels: test the fasttext model's get_labels method with include_freq=True to retrieve labels and frequencies
review_load_model: review the fasttext load_model function used to load a pre-trained model for vocabulary inspection
